hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_CAMERA RAM kernel FIT with display, controller-readback and camera diagnostics
Static FFS RAM root with LVGL

scenario: Boot the diagnostic kernel and RAM root, read CO5300 status and framebuffer counters, inspect selected GPIO/GPSPI registers, start the LVGL wscons example, and check visible output.
expected: The controller diagnostics provide usable status and the example produces a visible interface while refresh activity continues.
observed: CO5300 attach-time SPI read transactions completed without reported bus errors but yielded all-zero ID (00:00:00), power, format and brightness values. The initial framebuffer scan reported rows_changed=480, rows_sent=480, errors=0 and last_error=0. After starting LVGL and a three-second wait, both row counters were 961 with no errors; the process remained alive. At the captured register snapshot, hp_hold1, hp_hold0 and lp_padctrl were all zero. GPSPI reported clkrst=00800043, gate=00000003, clock=80000000, user=08002040, user1=00400000, misc=0000003e and int_raw=00001000. The OV3640 sensor identification failed with error 5; the driver programmed reset and power-down asserted. The operator confirmed that the display remained completely black.
limits: One sample and a short RAM trial; the installed NOR image was not updated.
Completed SPI read transactions with zero-valued results, SPI completion and row counters do not establish a valid panel identity or prove that the panel received valid commands or pixels.
Register snapshots describe captured register state, not measured pad voltage or physical bus timing; zero low-power hold registers do not establish a power fault.

The camera identification failure and resulting reset/power-down state do not identify the sensor or establish camera function. This trial did not repeat the separately recorded touch-input check or establish calibration, audio or Wi-Fi operation.
Raw UART logs and local device identifiers remain private.
